headline: Peru Inspects 58 Mining Waste Facilities Over El Niño Rain Hazards
summary: Peru's environmental oversight agency OEFA identified 58 mining waste units across 14 regions that are vulnerable to El Niño rains, requesting emergency risk-mitigation plans from mine operators.
why: Peru is the world's second-largest copper producer; infrastructure vulnerabilities and tailing dam risks from severe weather can disrupt major mine outputs and trigger environmental liabilities.

impacts.name: Peruvian Mining Sector
impacts.why: Demands for emergency response plans could increase operating compliance costs or lead to output interruptions.
